marketInsight: Massive initial submission volumes created an extreme oversupply of PSA 8s and 9s. Buyers looking for raw copies to gamble on a 10 keep raw prices artificially inflated.
Due to centering strictness on this specific print run, collectors heavily dump 8s to recoup grading fees, making the slab a massive discount for binder collectors.
A PSA 9 of this card guarantees structural authenticity and zero micro-scratches, yet trades at a discount compared to risky unverified raw copies on secondary marketplaces.
